accountant_is_configured.meaning: the Vault has an Accountant configured

slot_registration_active_before.meaning: an active registration exists for the target BLP slot before the call

slot_readable_and_active_verified.meaning: the supplied slot has been verified readable and active before notifyVaultSupply is called

stale_slot_registered.meaning: the stale BLP supplied slot remains registered in vaultSupplied

backing_accounting_monitoring_unavailabl.meaning: Vault backing/surplus accounting and monitoring are unavailable
backing_accounting_monitoring_unavailabl.checkpoint: while the stale slot remains registered

assumptions: The Accountant being configured and the absence of an active slot registration are the report-stated BEFORE facts for this scenario.
notifyVaultSupply is the checked action whose ordering against slot readability/activity verification is at issue.

unresolved.description: The intent requires notifyVaultSupply to be called only after verifying the slot is readable and active; the report does not state whether the verification is a precondition of the call or a post-call check, so the ordering relation is encoded as a required-effect condition rather than a strict temporal order.
Whether HyperCore leaves the slot inactive is conditional and the report gives no deterministic trigger for the stale registration.

limitations: The impact is encoded as a Boolean unavailability outcome; the report gives no numeric definition of backing/surplus accounting values.
The temporal qualifier 'while the stale slot remains registered' is represented by the stale_slot_registered symbol at the post-call checkpoint.
Other selected intents for this impact are formalized in separate claims and are not combined here.
